verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's docs explicitly document image generation and editing via natural-language prompts, with reference-image transforms, in-canvas commenting/annotation, and mobile photo-to-image workflows (chatgpt-docs-5, chatgpt-docs-6, chatgpt-docs-40, chatgpt-docs-45, chatgpt-docs-58, chatgpt-docs-82, chatgpt-docs-56, chatgpt-docs-78). This is a well-documented, mainstream first-party capability directly matching the knowledge-worker story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community verification specifically of the image-generation/editing feature (community evidence pack covers other features like code/browsing, not image gen).
